name: Wall push-up
cue: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands at chest height. Keep your body in one straight line.

name: Incline push-up
cue: Hands on a bench or table. Body straight from head to heels.

name: Knee push-up
cue: Knees on the floor, hips in line with shoulders and knees. Chest to a fist above the floor.

name: Push-up
cue: Hands under shoulders, body straight, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.

name: Diamond push-up
cue: Hands together under your chest, forming a diamond. Keep elbows tucked.

name: Decline push-up
cue: Feet on a bench, hands shoulder-width. Lower until your chest is near the floor.

name: Pike push-up
cue: Hips high in an upside-down V. Lower the top of your head between your hands.

name: Archer push-up
cue: Wide hands. Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. Count reps per side.

name: Pseudo planche push-up
cue: Hands by your hips, fingers pointing back or out, lean your shoulders past your hands.

name: Elevated pike push-up
cue: Feet on a bench, hips stacked over shoulders. Press up through the shoulders.

name: Chest-to-wall handstand hold
cue: Kick up with your belly toward the wall. Push tall through the shoulders and squeeze your legs together.

name: One-arm push-up
cue: Feet wide, hips square, free hand behind your back. Count reps per side.

name: Tuck planche
cue: Knees tucked, back rounded, arms straight, lean forward until your feet lift.

name: Wall handstand push-up
cue: Chest to the wall in a handstand. Lower your head to a mat, press back up.

name: Back-to-wall handstand hold
cue: Only heels touch the wall. Body long and straight, look at your hands.

name: Advanced tuck planche
cue: Hips level with shoulders, back flat, knees pulled in tight.

name: Freestanding handstand push-up
cue: Balance a handstand, lower with control, press up without the wall.

name: Freestanding handstand hold
cue: Kick up, stack wrists, shoulders, hips and feet. Control balance with your fingertips.

name: Dead hang
cue: Hang from a bar with straight arms and a firm grip. Keep your shoulders active, do not shrug.

name: Scapular pull-up
cue: Arms straight. Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift a few centimetres.

name: Inverted row
cue: Body straight under a low bar. Pull your chest to the bar.

name: Negative pull-up
cue: Jump or step to the top, then lower yourself slowly over about 5 seconds.

name: Pull-up
cue: Start from a dead hang. Pull until your chin clears the bar, lower fully.

name: Chin-up
cue: Palms facing you, hands shoulder-width. Chin over the bar.

name: Archer pull-up
cue: Wide grip. Pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. Count reps per side.

name: Explosive pull-up
cue: Pull fast and high, aiming your chest at the bar.

name: Tuck front lever
cue: Knees tucked, arms straight, back flat and parallel to the floor.

name: Negative muscle-up
cue: Start above the bar, lower slowly through the transition to a dead hang.

name: Advanced tuck front lever
cue: Open your hips a little, keep your back flat and hips level with shoulders.

name: Muscle-up
cue: False grip, pull explosively to your chest, roll over the bar, press out.

name: Assisted squat
cue: Hold a doorframe or pole for balance. Sit back and down, knees track over toes.

name: Bodyweight squat
cue: Feet shoulder-width. Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, chest up.

name: Split squat
cue: One foot forward, one back. Lower straight down. Count reps per side.

name: Bulgarian split squat
cue: Back foot on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is parallel. Count reps per side.

name: Shrimp squat
cue: Hold your rear foot behind you, lower until your back knee touches the floor. Count reps per side.

name: Assisted pistol squat
cue: Hold a pole or straps for support. Extend one leg forward and squat on the other. Count reps per side.

name: Pistol squat
cue: Free leg straight out, arms forward, heel down. Count reps per side.

name: Dead bug
cue: On your back, lower opposite arm and leg while your lower back stays pressed into the floor.

name: Plank
cue: Forearms down, body in one line, squeeze glutes and abs.

name: Hollow body hold
cue: On your back, lower back glued to the floor, arms and legs long, shoulders and feet lifted.

name: Hanging knee raise
cue: Hang from a bar, curl your knees to your chest without swinging.

name: Tuck L-sit
cue: Hands on parallettes or the floor, push down tall, knees tucked, feet off the ground.

name: Hanging leg raise
cue: Legs straight, raise to the bar with control, no swing.

name: L-sit
cue: Arms locked, shoulders pressed down, legs straight and parallel to the floor.

name: Tuck dragon flag
cue: Lie on a bench holding behind your head, lift your body with knees tucked, lower slowly.

name: Straddle front lever
cue: Legs straight and wide, body level under the bar, arms straight.

name: One-leg planche
cue: From advanced tuck, extend one leg straight back; hips stay level.

name: Dragon flag
cue: Straight body from shoulders to toes, lower slowly with control.

name: Hollow body hang
cue: Hang with arms straight, ribs down, legs together slightly in front: a hollow shape on the bar.

name: Hollow body hang, 30 s
cue: Same hollow shape, longer. No swinging.

name: Frog stand, toes touching
cue: Hands shoulder-width, knees on the backs of your arms, lean forward; keep toes lightly on the floor.

name: Frog stand
cue: Lean until the feet float. Look slightly forward, fingers grip the floor.

name: Pseudo planche lean
cue: Push-up position, fingers turned out, lean shoulders forward over the hands, arms straight.

name: Deep pseudo planche lean
cue: Shoulders well past the hands, protract the shoulder blades, body hollow.

name: Elbow lever, one leg down
cue: Elbows into the hips, lean forward until the body is level; one foot still touches.

name: Elbow lever
cue: Whole body level, balanced on the elbows at your hips.

name: Skin the cat
cue: From a hang, tuck and rotate backwards through your arms, then return. Slow and controlled.

name: German hang
cue: Hang with the arms behind you and the shoulders fully extended. Go only as deep as is comfortable.

name: Butcher's block stretch
cue: Kneel with elbows on a bench, hold a stick behind your head, sink the chest down. Opens the shoulders for handstands. Needs a bench and a stick.

name: Tuck back lever
cue: From a German hang, lift the hips until the back is level, knees tucked.

name: Advanced tuck back lever
cue: Back flat, hips open to 90 degrees.

name: Straddle back lever
cue: Legs straight and wide, body level.

name: Back lever
cue: Legs together, straight line from head to toes, level with the floor.

name: Compact leg lifts
cue: Sit with straight legs, hands beside the knees; lift both heels off the floor without leaning back.

name: Partial reverse Nordic
cue: Kneel tall, lean back in a straight line from knees to head, go only part way, come back up.

name: Reverse Nordic
cue: Full range lean back, hips stay straight, then return.

name: Straddle sit
cue: Sit with legs wide and straight, back tall, walk the chest forward. Flexibility for presses.

name: Shoulder stand
cue: Lie back, lift the hips and legs straight up, support the hips with the hands, body straight.

name: One-arm hang, towel assisted
cue: Hang from one hand, the other holds a towel over the bar for a little help. Count each side.

name: One-arm hang
cue: One hand only, shoulder active, no swinging. Count each side.

name: High L-sit
cue: From an L-sit, lift the legs above hip height, push the shoulders down hard.

name: V-sit
cue: Hands behind the hips, legs up high in a V.

name: Assisted sissy squat
cue: Hold a post, rise on the toes, knees travel forward while hips stay straight.

name: Sissy squat
cue: No support. Knees forward, body in a straight line from knees to head.

name: Gymnastics swing
cue: On the bar, move between hollow and arch with straight arms to build a controlled swing.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cue: Stand on one leg, hinge at the hip with a flat back, free leg goes back. Count each side.

name: Roll-back rocks
cue: Roll back onto the shoulders with hands by the ears, then rock forward fast.

name: Kip-up
cue: Roll back, push through the hands and kick the legs out to land on your feet. Use a soft surface.

name: Half dragon squat
cue: Squat on one leg while the other leg passes behind it; hold something for balance. Count each side.

name: Dragon squat
cue: Full depth, free leg behind and off the floor, no support. Count each side.

name: Table-top bridge
cue: Hands behind you, lift the hips until the body is flat like a table.

name: Back bridge
cue: From lying down, push up with hands by the ears into an arch; push the shoulders over the hands.

name: Parallel bar dip
cue: On parallel bars, lower until the shoulders are below the elbows, press back up.

name: Bulgarian dip
cue: On rings, turn the rings out and let the hands go wide at the bottom. Needs rings.

name: L-sit pull-up
cue: Hold the legs straight out in an L and pull up without swinging.

name: False-grip hang
cue: Wrists over the bar (or rings), palms sitting on top: the grip used for muscle-ups.

name: False-grip pull-up
cue: Keep the false grip all the way up and down.

name: Tuck L-sit to wall handstand
cue: From a tuck L-sit, lean forward and lift the hips until the feet reach the wall.

name: L-sit to handstand
cue: Press from L-sit into a freestanding handstand with straight arms.

name: 90-degree hold, feet on the wall
cue: Bent arms at 90 degrees, body level, feet resting on a wall behind you.

name: 90-degree hold
cue: Same position without the wall.

name: Straddle press from a box
cue: Hands on the floor, feet on a box, lean forward and lift the straddled legs into a handstand.

name: Straddle press
cue: From standing in a straddle, press to handstand with straight arms.

name: Pelican push-up
cue: An advanced deep push-up with the hands far back by the hips. Watch the video chapter for the exact form before trying.

name: Low-ring muscle-up transition
cue: On low rings with feet on the floor, practise turning over the rings with a false grip. Needs rings.

name: Ring muscle-up
cue: From a false-grip hang, pull, turn over the rings and press to support.

name: Straddle planche
cue: Straight arms, legs wide and straight, body level.

name: Straddle planche push-up
cue: Lower and press while holding the straddle planche.

name: Handstand to kip-up
cue: From a handstand, tuck the chin and roll down, then kip up to your feet in one flow. Use a soft surface.
